The consolidation is in place and compiles cleanly. Here's the summary.

## What I fixed

The real, single actionable item the reviewer anchored at **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:131`** was a block I introduced in the refactor and then **copied**: the "render a persisted owner as a 200 OK" sequence

```java
applyHouseholdMemberCount(owner);
OwnerDto ownerDto = ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner);
ownerDto.setBulkSignupWarning(bulkSignupWarning(owner.getRegistrationDate()));
return new ResponseEntity<>(ownerDto, HttpStatus.OK);
```

appeared verbatim in both `getOwner` (131–134) and `replayIdempotentCreate` (188–191), and its map-to-DTO pair was copied a third time in `createdOwnerResponse` (241–242).
